name: Manav Garima Yojana (Gujarat)
ministry: Gujarat Social Justice and Empowerment Department (Directorate of Scheduled Caste Welfare)
description: A Gujarat state self-employment scheme, meaning 'Human Dignity Scheme', that provides free trade toolkits to Scheduled Caste (SC) and NT-DNT families across 28 trades so they can start or improve a small home-based business without taking a loan.
benefits: Free trade-specific toolkit worth Rs. 4,000-5,000 (e.g. tailoring, embroidery, beauty parlour, mobile repair, cobbler, carpentry, welding, plumbing, food processing) with no repayment or interest, helping beneficiaries become self-reliant through self-employment.
eligibility: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Gujarat and belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) or NT-DNT category
Annual family income up to Rs. 6,00,000 (no income limit for certain most-backward SC sub-castes)
Applicant should not have already availed a similar toolkit benefit under this scheme
Willingness to pursue one of the 28 listed trades
how_to_apply: Apply online through the eSamaj Kalyan portal (esamajkalyan.gujarat.gov.in) by registering with Aadhaar, date of birth, caste category, and mobile number, completing OTP verification, filling in personal/family details exactly as per Aadhaar, and selecting 'Manav Garima Yojana' from the scheme list to submit the application with documents.
